items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] How about Tricky Sam? How did you like his playing? ... [INTERVIEWER] I loved it, I did... He used a mute. ... [INTERVIEWER] But I loved his playing. Yeah, we was just like that.

ctx.x: I told Joe Glaser I wanted to play with Louis Armstrong. So that's the way it went. Lou and I were just like buddies...(!) So that's all I know.
How about Tricky Sam? How did you like his playing?
I loved it, I did... He used a mute.
